name: simulate-apply-flows-boundary
why: Measured reach for the annual voluntary-withdrawal apply-flow planner extracted from simulatePlan. Four dedicated block-W members run in all four equivalence modes. W1 exhausts every positive balance class and reaches taxable-sale, equity-basis, ordinary-subtraction, inherited/owned traditional runtime, Roth, HSA, no-operation, evidence-write and owned-IRA application paths. W2 makes duplicate-id last-wins evidence identity and post-election spouse treat-as-own suppression observable. W3 makes the exact basis-minus-taken-times-ratio equity-compensation association observable across annual re-entry. W4 forces the Roth side of the qualified evidence test and the inherited zero fallback. Helper ranges and caller-consumption ranges are split around defensive invariant throws so zero cold executable whole lines is a meaningful requirement rather than an aggregate-range accident.

entries.label: last-wins evidence-account index, post-flip suppression, and explicit voluntary writes
positional balance/basis shadow and positive-withdrawal selection
committed taxable-sale balance and basis result
entries.note: The missing-sale branch on lines 115-117 is excluded: planWithdrawals creates a taxableSales record whenever it allocates a positive taxable draw. The structural `else` line 118 is excluded because V8 maps its branch entry to the closing brace and reports that whole line cold even when the taxable body runs; lines 119-121 are the actual committed result reads. The helper's supported defensive missing-map input and the caller-timed failure are pinned by focused direct and delegation tests.

ordered shadow writes, runtime/application verdicts, and complete result

entries.note: The evidence-position throw body on lines 9090-9093 is excluded: the helper enumerates the supplied evidence array and copies each row's account id. Hostile delegation tests prove the invariant.

entries.note: The position/source-before guard and throw on lines 9099-9106 are excluded because the helper enumerates the same balance positions and advances its repeated-object shadow in original mutation order. Hostile delegation tests cover wrong position and wrong source balance.

taxable-sale completeness check
entries.note: The failure body on line 9137 is excluded because the annual withdrawal planner supplies every positive taxable sale. Focused delegation injects the missing-sale verdict and pins the exact caller-timed error.

readingTheCounts: A member count proves that at least one line in the named range executed. The reach command additionally fails on any cold executable whole line inside a reached range. JavaScript line coverage cannot distinguish every optional-chain, nullish, compound-condition, or short-circuit operand sharing one physical line, so cold sub-line regions and the focused helper/delegation guards must be read alongside this differential proof.
